summary: Session of 2026-11-10 (after F3 T3.5): cleaned the tree and fixed what T2 found, closed REG-320, added the calibration report, scrubbed fix text. (1) The 31 files the 2026-11-08 session left uncommitted were reviewed and landed as three commits (portable tooling in T2 + the npdev python probe; nav groups follow the app language; docs refresh); the stale CHANGELOG working copy is in stash@{0} (its one unique entry is committed). (2) First full T2 with -IncludePaperwork: 5 gates failed on three causes -- kernel coverage floor re-pinned 71.5342 -> 71.5298 (noise, no kernel change since 11-03, same as four earlier times); two doc references fixed at their source (README orderTotal -> real rollup names, answer.txt -> --text-file -); REG-320 reconciled. (3) REG-320 DONE by decision (c): a removal of a record type or field is shown but not offered for Apply in the Manager (CLI preview flag needsSchemaAcknowledgment; relay apply on the CLI unchanged); Manager 0.13.34; proven on the real window against a real app model (reg320-tour 9/9) which also found two real bugs, fixed: the Rust pipe rejected the > in every RENAME code, and the i18n engine let a short template beat a more specific one. REG-321 (finish a confirmed removal: npdev upgrade --app --allow-destructive passes the impact gate but the boot step never gets the token), REG-322 (Manager fix button; the CLI half is done) and REG-323 (F4: fragments, element upsert, themes/pages, config proposals, code quarantine) are open ledger items. (4) npdev ai relay stats [--csv|--json] prints the calibration-log rows from the stored conversations. (5) npdev_relay_scrub.py: a fix conversation's error text is scrubbed by the CLI (secrets redacted, app folder -> app, home -> home, other absolute paths -> last name). (6) GitHub: Identity journeys and F6 showcase fail at Checkout ScrapForAI engine since 03:35 UTC today because the ScrapForAI repo was recreated PRIVATE and NPDevGeneral has no secret; nothing was changed on GitHub; the owner has not answered the question put to them (A deploy key recommended, B PAT, C make it public). A final T2 run (-IncludePaperwork) was STARTED at 17:08 local from this session: its generator gate PASSED (so the kernel floor fix holds); the other gates were still running when the session closed.
nextStep: FIRST, read the verdict of the final T2 run started at 17:08 local on 2026-11-10 (commit 1a9c4dd8): log D:/WorkSpace/NPDev/Build/digest-logs/20261110T200823Z-pwsh--NoProfile--File.log -- run grep -n -A8 "== Summary ==" on it. It was started as a child of the closed session, so it may have been killed: if the log has no Summary block and no process named run-all-gates is alive, rerun it: python scripts/ai/run_digest.py -- pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/quality/run-all-gates.ps1 -IncludePaperwork (about 30 min; never edit the repo, and never run clean-workspace-state.ps1, while it runs: it deletes the node_modules the gate installs). The generator gate already PASSED. Expect all green; if something is red, it is new since the first run (that run's three causes were fixed). THEN: (a) commit the handoff files if they are still uncommitted (ledger/session-state/current.json and history.jsonl; run scripts/hygiene/clean-workspace-state.ps1 first if the commit hook says slimness) and push; (b) ask the owner about GitHub (see BLOCKED) and, on a yes to A, do it end to end with gh (it has admin scopes): ssh-keygen an ed25519 key, add the public half as a READ-ONLY deploy key on MarceloGiazzon/ScrapForAI, store the private half as an Actions secret on NPDevGeneral, change the two checkouts in .github/workflows/journeys.yml and f6-showcase.yml to ssh-key, rerun both and confirm green; (c) engineering that needs no owner: REG-322 (Manager Ask the AI to fix this button, steps in the item), then REG-321 (platform change in npdev_app_upgrade.py), then REG-323 (F4, one commit per item, T4.2 first). stash@{0} holds only a stale CHANGELOG copy: drop it once the owner agrees.

The final T2 verdict is pending (see NEXT). No other blocker.
